core_sell_guard_d174.arming: Exact current-round radar: week52Position >= 0.95 and at least two existing D-161 overheat signals. Arming never permits an immediate sale.
core_sell_guard_d174.pullback_reference: D-205 (2026-11-02): Steven authorized a 1.5% high-water pullback; completed-session KD and all other confirmation and execution gates remain. This parameter is not optimized or performance-validated.
core_sell_guard_d174.confirmation: Two consecutive completed-session K declines; latest completed K < D and D declines; both declining sessions must be after the retained high date; live radar K < D must still hold. Use aligned source daily K/D, not intraday bars as completed days.

v2_official_sma20_verification.rule: D-174 accepts V2 only when the required official SMA20 verification is present, non-CONFLICT and reports gateApplied=false. CONFLICT always blocks this timing leg because V2 may retain a sell candidate while downgrading its executable action to HOLD or WATCH.

core_sell_guard_d174.state: Consumer-isolated persisted high-water watch. Ratchet upward, cash-adjust to the current price basis, never reset on a new report or unfilled recommendation. Missing state starts a new watch with no same-day sale; corrupt or mismatched state fails only this timing leg.
core_sell_guard_d174.exception_evidence: An existing mandatory rule, dated evidence and amount/threshold must be identified. Ordinary overweight, target zero, defensive risk mode, management dates and TIMEBOX_EXIT cannot be relabelled as mandatory risk.
core_sell_guard_d174.model_treatment: Daily-only timing guard. The monthly retirement model lacks daily KD and watch-state evidence; neither historical success rates nor this guard claim improved return. Full-cost out-of-sample comparison remains unmeasured.

low_point_sell_protection_d208.scope: Ordinary D-174 core reductions/exits only. Latest completed daily K/D and same-round exact live radar K/D must each be strictly above 50. Any low/oversold/rebound stock technical evidence vetoes this leg. Missing evidence fails closed; keep observation history. Existing separately proved emergency exits remain separate, with no user-supplied bypass flag.
low_point_sell_protection_d208.validation: Conservative execution threshold, not optimized or proven to avoid market bottoms; no return or retirement-success claim.

high_zone_reversal_d209.scope: Only ordinary Taiwan 00919 D-174 core reductions/exits, rotation sells and TIMEBOX_EXIT. Latest completed daily D and same-round exact live radar D must both be at least 80. K may fall below 80 while still satisfying D-208 low-point protection. This gate does not replace the original completed-session K declines, K<D, high-water timing, pullback, radar or execution gates.
high_zone_reversal_d209.validation: User-selected conservative high-zone execution threshold; not optimized, no guarantee of detecting tops or avoiding bottoms; no quantity or emergency-rule change.

us_megacap_tactical_policy_d133.scope: US_MEGACAP_TACTICAL_ELIGIBLE evaluation for individual US stocks outside the VOO/VT/SGOV buy-and-hold core (see portfolio/US_MEGACAP_TACTICAL_PLAN.md). VOO, VT and SGOV are the only long-term-hold US positions; every other authorized US ticker is short-term tactical only under a US_TACTICAL_TRADE_ID, never reclassified as core.

candidate_universe.primary_path: Any ticker appearing on the current round's fresh, verifiable, non-stale US-stock trading radar list (one successful GET /api/public/trading-radar/stock call per candidate with matching stockCode and market=美股) is eligible for evaluation. D-181 removes the prior requirement that a radar-listed candidate also be in the global top-10 market cap, be a US tech giant, or show a 12-month auditable positive return; those three conditions no longer gate a radar-listed name.
candidate_universe.fallback_path: A ticker NOT on the current round's radar list may still be evaluated only if it satisfies all three of: (a) global top-10 market cap by verifiable diluted shares outstanding and a qualified price, cross-checked against at least one independent source, with the existing D-139 10th/11th-place boundary exception (both candidates evaluated and MARKET_CAP_BOUNDARY_10_11 disclosed when ranking is disputed only at that boundary; unverifiable rank or a dispute beyond 10th/11th stays MARKET_CAP_RANK_UNVERIFIED, no trade); (b) US tech giant (US-registered, primarily US-operated, core business in semiconductors, hardware/software, cloud, internet platforms, or AI infrastructure/applications; merely being US-listed, or having tech as an incidental business, does not qualify); (c) a 12-month base/pessimistic/optimistic scenario showing a positive base-case net return after commissions, spread, FX and applicable tax, with estimated upside at least twice the downside risk.
candidate_universe.not_a_permanent_whitelist: This is a dynamic tactical universe, not a permanent core addition. An unheld eligible name's strategic target remains 0%; only one open, compliant US_TACTICAL_TRADE_ID per name may be held temporarily.
candidate_universe.other_gates_unchanged: Sections 2-6 of portfolio/US_MEGACAP_TACTICAL_PLAN.md (same-direction radar requirement, bull-drawdown entry conditions, position/funding/cost caps, exit and one-year time limit, report disclosure) apply unchanged regardless of which path qualified the candidate. A FALLBACK candidate absent from the list must first pass all three fallback qualifications, then obtain exactly one successful current-read detail using the Swagger-documented stockCode/market selector; verify identity, version, session and BUY/ADD direction against this round. The current-read endpoint only returns an existing current result and may return 404; unavailable detail means WATCH_ONLY/US_RADAR_REQUIRED_FAIL, never refresh, fabricate a route or substitute JSON. Both paths must satisfy D-185 net profit space of at least 15%.

buy_limit_price_basis.problem: Prior US-stock reports were observed proposing buy limit prices far below the live executable price (fillable only on a severe same-day crash), apparently because an oversold/pullback entry SIGNAL level (KD, RSI5, BIAS10, W%R9, a support level, or a moving average) was reused as the LIMIT PRICE itself.
buy_limit_price_basis.rule: The entry signal (radar turning BUY_CANDIDATE/ADD_CANDIDATE, bull-drawdown stabilization evidence, and any KD/RSI/BIAS/W%R oversold reading per kd_role) decides ONLY whether a trade is authorized this round. It must never be reused as, or to derive, the limit price. The limit price is computed separately from live data so the order is realistically fillable the same session.
buy_limit_price_basis.price_basis: Use this round's successfully retrieved live US quote: the most recent trade price, or the bid/ask midpoint when both sides are available. Round to the security's normal minimum US tick (typically US$0.01). A small buffer toward the executable side is permitted to raise fill probability; the limit must not be set materially below the live quote merely to wait for a lower fill.
buy_limit_price_basis.no_fresh_quote: If no fresh, verifiable live quote (trade price or bid/ask) is available this round, the candidate is US_RADAR_REQUIRED_FAIL / no executable order today; never derive a limit price from a stale price, a prior session's close, or an estimate.
buy_limit_price_basis.note: kd_role already states this intent ("KD only adjusts the timing, priority, tranches, and limit price of an already-authorized trade") but no prior policy text spelled out a concrete US price basis; D-181 supplies one because etf_premium_discount_policy_d124's best-five-depth formula is TW-only (market=台股) and D-108 explicitly does not require US best-five depth.

minimum_profit_space_d185.rule: D-185 (2026-09-26): a US tactical candidate (radar-primary or fallback path) must show at least a 15% gap between the estimated entry price and the estimated fair/target price (前高/合理價) before it is worth recommending, net of commissions, spread, FX conversion and applicable Taiwan overseas-income tax. Steven's reasoning: US stocks have no daily price-move limit (漲跌幅限制) unlike Taiwan's 10%, so a short-term trade needs a bigger cushion to be worth the added overnight-gap and volatility risk plus round-trip costs; The US net profit-space threshold remains 15%; the Taiwan equity sleeve now separately requires a 3% entry-confirmation rebound under D-210, and the bond rebound remains 5%. These thresholds measure different conditions.
minimum_profit_space_d185.interacts_with: This is additional to, not a replacement for, section 3 point 4's separate 12-month base/pessimistic/optimistic reward:risk test (fallback-path candidates only, upside >= 2x downside). A radar-primary candidate that skips point 4 under D-181 still needs this 15% entry-to-target space check before recommendation.

order_check_d186.rule: D-186 (2026-09-26): before any D-133 US tactical buy may show a share count, USD limit price or amount, the report must run scripts/us_tactical_order_check.py on this round's saved candidate evidence (qualification path, radar detail, live quote, proposed limit, target price with basis, cost rates, proposed TWD notional and open tactical positions). The calculator enforces D-181's candidate path and same-direction radar, D-181's live-quote limit basis (reference = bid/ask midpoint, else last trade, same US session, quoteStatus LIVE; the limit must sit within 0.5% below to 0.5% above that reference and on the Rule 612 tick), D-185's 15% net entry-to-target space after commission, spread, FX spread and tax, and section 4's 0.25% batch / 0.75% company / 2% sleeve caps. Any reason code means NO_EXECUTABLE_ORDER for that name today; PASS_FOR_REPORT_REVIEW is necessary but not sufficient, because section 3 bull-drawdown, fundamentals, funding floors and CATHAY_TWD_US_TACTICAL checks still apply. The 0.5% tolerance is the numeric reading of D-181's 'not materially below the live quote'. The calculator never fetches data or places orders.

dip_research_review_d206.scope: Research and reporting for individual stocks in the existing verified US universe; US tech giants are a research focus, not an additional primary-path eligibility condition or a permanent whitelist.
dip_research_review_d206.cash_flow_rule: Negative FCF requires a sourced explanation of capex, working capital or one-off payments, funding, monetization evidence and payback horizon. It is not automatically permanent impairment or a new veto; positive FCF is not automatically fair valuation.
dip_research_review_d206.valuation_rule: Separate GAAP, sourced normalized earnings, trailing and forward periods, and cash-flow valuation. Explain material one-offs and provider differences. Drawdown, oversold readings, prior highs and analyst average targets alone cannot establish fair value. Use verified API facts or deterministic tools, never LLM arithmetic.
dip_research_review_d206.missing_evidence: UNKNOWN for the affected dimension; WATCH_ONLY when an existing necessary D-133 entry condition cannot be verified. Do not create a global veto for secondary-source gaps.
dip_research_review_d206.execution_boundary: Research labels never override exact US-market RISK_OFF, radar BUY/ADD, bull-drawdown stabilization, D-185 net 15%, D-186, funding floors, 0.25% batch / 0.75% company / 2% sleeve caps or exit rules. Preserve BLOCKED; no shares, USD limit or amount until all original conditions pass.
